desc: Prove that every legal game position is bipartite and characterize all legal edge additions within and between connected components.
Determine that every terminal graph is a complete bipartite graph on all N vertices, while its bipartition can depend on merge orientations.
Derive and prove the correct game-theoretic winner criterion for all \(N\), including odd \(N\) and an odd number of odd-order components.

Validate the revised criterion by exhaustive small-graph game analysis and all three samples, including empty graphs and components of types \((\mathrm{even},\mathrm{even})\), \((\mathrm{odd},\mathrm{odd})\), and \((\mathrm{odd},\mathrm{even})\).
Design an \(O(N+M)\) BFS/DFS procedure to color components and collect the statistics required by the corrected criterion.
Implement the corrected stdin/stdout Python solution and verify that it passes the samples.
